scope: Read-only offline verification of 600 canonical results and their saved judge responses. No new model calls, browsers, jobs or rescoring.
interpretation: DONE is an agent stop action, not independently proven task completion.
Mentions of eight effective/correct actions are textual observations, not false-positive counts.
Prior review notes are targeted evidence flags, not a representative estimate of judge error.
Leniency is demonstrated in saved examples, but its causal contribution to the cross-harness success gap is unmeasured.
The difference in judging step-limit trajectories alone affects six Jev and one Kev positive records; it cannot alone explain the headline gap.
No adjusted success rate is calculated, and canonical verdicts remain unchanged.

changes_from_canonical: Evidence-only input without actor thoughts or old verdicts
strict_secondary_preparation.interpretation: A changed rate is not an isolated causal estimate of rubric leniency: evidence also changes, and no matched SFT baseline has yet been rejudged.
strict_secondary_preparation.relative_date_policy: Never resolve relative dates against rejudge date; require a supplied original reference date or preserve relevant uncertainty.
